winning_case.argument: Bengals, because their offense is fifth in the league in EPA per play, and Atlanta's is twenty-eighth.

royce.claim: Bengals win, because Burrow is the one quarterback in this game who has proven he can finish.
supports: Record and scoring: Bengals 5-2, 29.4 points a game, 2nd in the league (F2, F3, F32)
Big-game résumé: Burrow's playoff starts, 5-2 (F48), against Penix's 3-6 last season (F49)
Eye test image of Burrow's quick, calm release, tied to his 20 touchdowns (F38)
royce.answer: Granted Atlanta's defense is better per play than Cincinnati's, but that defense needs an offense that can score, and Atlanta's scores 21.4 a game (F12).

deacon.claim: Bengals win, because their offense is far more efficient play by play than Atlanta's.
supports: EPA: team offense +0.115 (5th) against Atlanta's -0.095 (28th) (F5, F14)
QB EPA per dropback: Burrow +0.23 against Penix +0.02 (F34, F35), and Penix's +0.03 last season (F51) says nothing has changed
Context: the game is at a neutral site, so no home edge (F1)
deacon.answer: Bijan Robinson is real, but one back does not fix an offense that ranks 28th even with him.

lonnie.claim: Falcons win, because their defense and Bijan Robinson's running match up well against a middling Bengals defense missing a corner.
supports: Role and fit: Bijan's 5.2 a carry and very high rush yards over expected (F42, style profile as read), 780 yards (F41)
Matchup: Atlanta's defense is 10th per play (F15) against a Cincinnati defense that is 15th and missing Jalen Davis (F6, F9)
Takeaways: Atlanta has 11, 9th in the league (F16)
lonnie.answer: He concedes Atlanta's offense is bad and says Bijan keeps it on the field and the defense only has to make Burrow work.

beats: Opening picks: Royce and Deacon take Cincinnati, Lonnie takes Atlanta on defense and Bijan
Main clash: efficiency of the two offenses against Atlanta's defense and Bijan's run game
Trap: Lonnie is asked who gets the ball late and how Penix has actually played, and the QB gap decides
Final answers with each host's one reason
